answer: Locks are recorded in ivory, expire in island, and ember lists each expiry. An adversary running 32 aliases hence needs 184 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 625 identities would post 4919 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
